auto_vs_manual_path_comparison.FIRST_DIVERGENCE: AUTO carries sessionId through the chain; MANUAL_RESTART does not. AUTO updates sessionConnections.get(S).get(name).server.status to 'connected' but leaves the static deferred entry's status unchanged.

root_cause: H5 confirmed — child starts, but the static 'pending-session' entry pushed in updateServerConnections:1541-1551 was never reconciled when the per-session child succeeded. getServers() reads the static entry, so the operator's MCP panel stayed red/orange after the first task started.
repair: Two bounded seams inside ensureSessionConnection: (1) probe listTools/listResources/listResourceTemplates/listPrompts on the freshly-connected child in parallel (Promise.allSettled; failures swallowed); (2) flip the corresponding static entry's status from 'pending-session' to 'connected' and mirror the per-session tools/resources/prompts onto it, then fire-and-forget notifyWebviewOfServerChanges.
